Hard1_later_winner_cut: strictly later than Hard1 sell bar, later High reaches Entry+3% or+5%; stop-bar only touch excluded/ambiguous
Hard1_saved_loss: Hard1 trigger and both known; baseline negative and HARD1 return greater than STATE_EXIT
MFE_realization: 100*realized_return/positive opportunity_MFE; report ratio mean/median without clipping
Peak_Giveback: held observed MFE through bars strictly before sell minute minus realized_return (pp); fill-bar High excluded; stop-bar intrabar order unknown
opportunity_MFE: frozen strictly-later observed same-session High relative to fill; observed lower bound when source partial
opportunity_giveback: full-session observed MFE minus realized_return, includes upside after early exit; separately named
paired_primary: both arms sell-filled; each single arm filled N and unresolved N also reported
primary_unit: same frozen filled Entry / WATCH_KEY; same test fold
return: 100*(sell_fill/frozen_entry_fill-1), commission0; equal-entry mean/median, not portfolio/session capital return
source_completeness: scheduled eligible bars from Entry fill through each exit; missing minutes not manufactured; paired complete subset also shown
winner_basis: observed Entry-relative opportunity_MFE >= threshold; partial path lower-bound diagnosis separated
